summary: Transformation is more than replacing one state with another. The Zhuangzi closes 齊物論 with 物化, the transformation of things.

satellites.title: Transformation of Things
satellites.evidence: At the end of 齊物論, the butterfly dream leads to 物化. This is a passage about transformation, not a literal biological metamorphosis account.

cites.locator: ch. 2 齊物論, end 物化

satellites.title: The Great Smith of Change
satellites.evidence: Zhuangzi 6 (Dazongshi): 今一以天地為大鑪，以造化為大冶，惡乎往而不可哉 — “take heaven and earth as the great furnace and the maker-of-change as the great smith: where could I go that would not do?”, said by a dying man who will not ask to be recast as anything in particular.
